purpose: Deliver a finite open v1.2 product release that provides bounded minimum-quality coverage across the material human-AI collaboration lifecycle, is actually installable and usable on Codex, preserves dynamic native-first capability and carrier adaptation, fills only evidenced residual gaps, survives controlled historical and adversarial counterexamples, and is reproducible and releasable with explicit human authority. The current shortfall corpus is a requirements and counterexample source rather than a feature backlog; coverage permits sufficient native or external reuse and honest degradation, escalation, stop or claim limitation instead of requiring a bespoke Harness mechanism or static perfect score. Natural-task burden reduction, broad real-world effectiveness, distinct-Agent equivalence, and untested operating-system behavior remain continuing field-validation claims rather than release-completion prerequisites. v0.2 remains an immutable bounded calibration milestone, while v1.0 and v1.1 remain immutable stopped zero-outcome attempts; none can satisfy this program by inheritance.

increments.observedProblem: O1 requires twelve distinct fixed-source lifecycle dispositions with exercised controlled effects, while the current verifier intentionally has no outcome validator; executing or recording any scenario before a task-specific validator is committed would make the evidence post-hoc, and closing twelve unpromoted fragment increments would violate the bounded process-loss rule.
increments.hypothesis: One task-specific deep module with only the existing registration and evidence validator interfaces, plus a local-substitutable controlled probe, can bind all twelve source slices before execution, reject mapping or self-report as proof, replay observable verifier effects, and avoid creating a generic runtime, evidence service or new authority layer.
increments.falsifier: The module accepts fewer than SG-01 through SG-12 exactly once, trusts receipt assertions or test counts without replaying observable effects, permits a route without a bounded unsupported disposition, depends on post-measurement code, changes the frozen profile or protocol, or exposes a reusable runtime or evidence schema beyond this exact O1 suite.
increments.stopCondition: The exact O1 suite probe and validator interfaces are committed before registration, focused tests prove fail-closed registration and evidence behavior through those interfaces, the canonical verifier remains valid with O1 still false, and this outcome-neutral increment leaves the current graph with no task-created residue.

deliverables: task-specific O1 lifecycle-suite probe and validator interfaces
registration and evidence fail-closed regression coverage
